segments.name: Online shoppers facing a current fit-sensitive purchase decision
segments.description: Hypothesis: shoppers considering an item where one missing physical fact could cause a costly return and where retailer documentation does not resolve the question.
segments.whyNow: A purchase decision is pending and the missing fact blocks confidence; frequency and urgency remain UNKNOWN.

triggers.description: A shopper has a specific, objective product question that available listings and reviews do not answer.
triggers.urgencyWindow: Before the intended purchase; actual duration UNKNOWN
triggers.messageImplication: Resolve one objective purchase blocker with guided evidence.

offers.name: Single guided proof request
offers.deliverable: One checklist-bound visual proof response for one objective product question.
offers.scope: One request, one evidence checklist, no product-quality guarantee.

price.basis: per completed proof request; proposed platform-fee split remains unverified

channels.name: Contextual shopping communities
channels.accessPath: Only permission-respecting communities where product questions are already asked; no automated outreach.
